messages:
alex: Thinking out loud — for the console econ tiles we're showing per-invocation token_cost and cache_savings, but product wants a 'net cost' tile that attributes cache savings across routes. Any concerns about attribution accuracy or perf of computing this on the fly? cc @maya @darren

maya: My first concern is double-counting when the same prefetch/KV is consumed by multiple routes. Suggestion: show conservative attribution (attribute to first route that used the cache) and add a 'shared-savings' hover detail that explains overlaps.

darren: That sounds fine from a UX POV but backend wise precise lineage requires joining request_id -> cache_fingerprint logs which is heavy. Options: sample, pre-aggregate, or do hourly batch attribution.

linh: On telemetry — we already emit cache_hit events with fingerprint + route. To make attribution better we'd need to add `prefetch_origin` and `tenant_affinity` fields. Small schema change but straightforward.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dashboard-export job on staging (flag: econ_tiles_v2). logs: https://ci/internal/12345 :white_check_mark:

alex: Sampling is okay as long as the UI is explicit — show a 'sampled estimate' badge with confidence interval. Also product wants per-model breakdown (quantized vs fp16) in the same card for unit econ.

maya: UX mock: tile rows => model | net_tokens | cached_tokens | requests | note (sampled/estimated). Drilldown opens a per-route timeline and a toggle for 'show raw vs attributed'.

darren: Implementation idea — precompute hourly aggregates keyed by (hour, model, route, cache_fp) with counts + cached_savings_tokens. At query time merge aggregates for the time window and run a cheap attribution pass across routes within that hour. Avoids big real-time joins.

linh: That works. We'll need to send a backfill for `cache_origin` for the last 14 days so the first rollout has decent historical data. Backfill estimate: ~20M events, should be ok if batched.

alex: Rollout plan proposal: console feature flag + API toggle `econ_mode=attributed` default off. Start with sampled attribution for 10% tenants for 48h, then widen. Also surface disclaimer: 'Net tokens = raw tokens - attributed cached tokens (sampled)'.

maya: :thumbsup: Add short tooltip copy so PMs/finance don't misread numbers. Keep legal/hedging language out of primary tile.

darren: Important edge-case: multi-route/chained model calls. If an invocation triggers downstream routes, attribution gets fuzzy. Mark those chains as 'multi-route' and hide/don't attribute until chain-aware logic is in place.

linh: I'll open a telemetry PR with the `cache_origin` + `prefetch_origin` fields and draft a migration/backfill runbook.

darren: example event snippet for telemetry consumers: `{"ts": 1781944999, "route": "search-api", "model": "redwood-v1-q4", "cache_fp": "abc123", "cached_tokens": 120}`

alex: thanks all — filing a small project in backlog with the rollout checklist and will follow up on the PRs.
